description.value:
Regalia — Cursed Technique Reversal

Due to mastering Reverse Cursed Technique, you have learned your cursed technique reversal. Instead of releasing the seal on your soul’s cursed tool, you can instead seal the cursed tools of others. Once per turn, when you hit a creature wielding or using a cursed tool, you can spend 4 CE to force them to make a Cursed Energy save against your DC. On a failure, a cursed tool of your choice that the target is wielding or wearing becomes non-functional. The target gains a -2 penalty to the save for every rarity below Special Grade the targeted cursed tool is. They lose any benefits of the cursed tool and their attunement breaks if they are attuned. The cursed tool reverts to a non-functional cursed object without any bonuses and cannot be attuned to for 1 hour. After the hour has passed, the item returns to normal and can be attuned to.

effects.name: Cursed tool sealed
effects.description: A chosen cursed tool is non-functional for 1 hour (unattune it). −2 to the save per grade below Special.
